data.name: Hoshmand
data.gender_notes: Hoshmand is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is luminous, radiant, shining, and full of wisdom and power. The name Hoshmand carries the meaning “Luminous, Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Hoshmand usually hope their child will grow to embody luminous, radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who illuminates and enlightens others, a beacon of light and knowledge
data.etymology: Hoshmand belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Luminous, Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hoshmand total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hindi.name: होशमंद

in_pashto.name: هوشمند

in_english.name: Hoshmand
in_english.long_meaning: Hoshmand is an Arabic-originated name that means intelligent, wise, and understanding. This name holds positive connotations in Islamic tradition, reflecting desirable personality traits such as wisdom, prudence, and good character.
